sample_unit: medical statements linked to MIMIC-IV patient contexts

links.outcome: LLM failure modes (hallucinated support, truth inversion) on patient-contextual factual and counterfactual statements
links.effect: Current proprietary, open-source, and domain-specific LLMs frequently exhibit hallucinated support and truth inversion; CoRFu fine-tuning eliminated truth inversion errors and improved macro-F1 by 16.4 points.
links.quote: Using this framework, we identify critical failure modes, including hallucinated support and truth inversion, that current proprietary, open-source, and domain-specific LLMs frequently exhibit.

unlisted_practices: Counterfactual risk-aware DPO fine-tuning with asymmetric penalty for unsafe confusions (CoRFu)
4-quadrant benchmark jointly assessing knowledge grounding and patient-context consistency

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated medical benchmark (MediEval) for LLMs on patient-contextual reasoning and proposes a fine-tuning method (CoRFu), which is model development/training rather than an organizational deployment practice.
